attributes.board_name: Utah Board of Pharmacy (Division of Professional Licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE-approved providers; nationally recognized health-related CE approval organizations (pharmacy-related); Division trainings; ACPE-accredited meetings of UPhA, USHP or other associations; approved certifications (e.g. CDE, board certification)
rules.new_licensee_rule: Hours are reduced proportionately for licensees first licensed during the two-year cycle.
rules.alternatives: The Division may defer or waive CE under R156-1-308d.
rules.audit_note: Keep proof 4 years after the cycle: NABP CPE Monitor registration plus certificates for CE it cannot track.

topics.who: Pharmacy law or ethics (Board meeting attendance may count, up to 2 h)
Pharmacists who give vaccines: vaccine topics, in addition to the 30

rules.notes: 12 of the 30 hours must be live or technology-enabled lectures/seminars/workshops. Extra 2 h each for pharmacists who give vaccines (vaccine topics), administer drugs/devices, or dispense hormonal contraceptives. Teaching earns 2 h per hour (max 10).
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-17b-309; renewal date R156-1-308a
